reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer, and I already forget my vitamins on the counter. The sachet is a nice idea for my bag, but I would not pay extra for it this week.
objection: $29.99 for 30 days is more than what I pay now, and I do not know if the sachet is worth the difference.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to $20 a box, or a cheap trial box so I can see if I actually remember to take it.
